title: Analog Gravity
description: A fluid flowing faster than its own sound has a horizon for sound, and the mathematics of sound on it is the mathematics of light near a black hole, Hawking radiation included. Unlocks the Analog Black Hole.

puzzle.goal: A horizon whose surface gravity is κ glows at a temperature T set by the quantum of action and the thermal energy scale. Write T.
puzzle.name: Hawking temperature
puzzle.ask: Find T in nK for a sonic horizon with K = @{K} s⁻¹ (h = 1.0546e-34 J·s for ħ, k = 1.381e-23 J/K).
puzzle.method: Near the horizon, modes are stretched exponentially at the rate κ; seen from far away that stretching looks like a thermal spectrum at kT = ħκ/2π.
